data.body:
[P2] Reconcile terminal acknowledgments received during cleanup

If an EXECUTION SUCCEED/FAIL request remains in flight at the cutoff, this flag is false and `InvocationDeadlineExceeded` escapes. Cleanup still joins the batcher, so the request can then succeed and set `_terminal_execution_acknowledged`, but the exception path skips both `check_invocation_result()` calls. The wrapper and invocation-end hook therefore report RETRY even though the terminal checkpoint is known to have succeeded before return. Reconcile that request's outcome after the mandatory join, or await its specific completion once dispatched, before propagating the deadline error. Add a regression test that holds the terminal checkpoint transport across the cutoff.
